summary: Allow 3 paced retries under the dogfood env and default --rate-limit to 1 req/s because screener.in throttles bursts.
reason: Screener.in returns 429 on burst access with short Retry-After windows; the generated client disables retries under dogfood and defaults to no pacing.
validated_outcome: Live dogfood improved from 196/203 to 202/203 with retries; 16/16 commands pass with spacing.
